title: Your bank’s fraud desk calls finance
scenario: A caller claiming to be the company’s bank says a wire is being held for fraud review. They know the company name and recent transfer amount and ask for a security code to release the hold.

answers.A: End the call and contact the bank using the treasury portal or known relationship-manager number.
answers.B: Freeze or review the transfer in the bank portal while independently contacting the bank.
answers.C: Read the code because the caller already knows the exact transfer amount.

explanation: Transaction details can leak through compromised email or systems. Security codes may authorize rather than cancel activity.
proTip: Knowing the transaction is not the same as controlling the bank.
